about: Midas verdicts for census-fnret.py (D-219/D-220's class: a function called or declared with a return type other than its definition's), round 5 (docs/port-ios/08-round5-census.md). Keyed by file + a regex on the source line. SAFE / NONPORT / DEAD = audited. Anything else (or no rule) fails --check.

rules.why: the N64/x86 arm (#else of PORT); the PORT arm declares the real prototype and passes the typed function (donor D-219, merged in round 2)
its only caller sub_GAME_7F0B2FE0 has no callers in the tree (matching-decomp artefact: bg.c defines it f32); nothing reads the value
proutSprintf returns char *, _Printf (port/src/printf_port.c) expects a u8 * callback: both pointers, same register and width
declared void *, defined ALSoundState *: both pointers
`long` vs `long int` is the same type (the script's spelling normaliser does not alias them)
declared void *, defined FILE *: both pointers
uint32_t is unsigned int on every host
